data.one_liner: Flutter data table with expandable rows for hidden columns.
data.what_it_does: Renders a tabular data view where columns exceeding a visible count collapse into a tappable expansion panel per row. It supports sorting, pagination, and built-in or custom row editing.
use_when: You have data tables with more columns than fit on mobile screen sizes
You want extra columns to be accessible via row expansion instead of horizontal scrolling
avoid_when: You need massive virtualized data grids with thousands of rows and complex infinite scrolling
You prefer standard horizontal scrolling data tables
strengths: Handles responsiveness for tables with many columns automatically
Supports built-in and custom row editing features
Extensible cell types and rich theming configuration options
weaknesses: Requires manual state management integration for row changes via callbacks
Limited to the specific layout and design paradigm of expandable row panels
data.minimal_example:
ExpandableDataTable(
  headers: headers,
  rows: rows,
  visibleColumnCount: 3,
)
